title: On conformal symmetry in large-$N$ quiver mechanics
summary: The microscopic description of extremal supersymmetric black holes in AdS$_2$/CFT$_1$ holography has remained elusive despite recent progress in the statistical description of near-extremal black hole physics. In this work we revisit Denef's quiver mechanics description of D-brane bound states in the Coulomb branch, which displays an emergent conformal symmetry in the AdS$_2$ scaling limit. This conformal symmetry is however broken by superpotential corrections near the locus where the Coulomb and Higgs branches meet, and its significance has so far remained unclear.
